WhyChooseMSG91.heading: Your customers are on WhatsApp. Is your business keeping up?
paragraphs: In the UAE, customers expect a fast reply on WhatsApp, in Arabic or English. But a single phone can't handle hundreds of chats. Templates get paused, numbers get blocked, and important messages fail without anyone noticing.
WhatsApp for business works best when every message is sent on time, every chat reaches the right person, and every reply sounds like your brand. That is what MSG91 is built for.

FeatureComp.heading: What can you do with MSG91 WhatsApp Business API?
FeatureComp.subheading: MSG91 WhatsApp Business Platform helps UAE businesses use WhatsApp for five jobs: marketing, sales, transactional updates, authentication (OTPs) and customer support. You run all of them from one account with one or more connected numbers. The features below are grouped by what you want to get done.

features.name: Bulk campaigns to the right people
features.content: Send offers, launches and seasonal deals to thousands of opted-in customers in one go. Filter your audience by city, language, last purchase or interest, so each person gets a message that fits. Schedule campaigns for the hour your customers are most active, and track delivery, reads and clicks live.

features.name: Journeys that follow up for you
features.content: Build a chain of messages that reacts to what each customer does. If they click, send the next offer. If they stay silent, send a reminder after a set time. Use a different template at each step. The journey runs on its own, so your team doesn't chase every lead by hand.

features.name: Click-to-WhatsApp ads
features.content: Run Instagram and Facebook ads that open a WhatsApp chat in one tap using Click-to-WhatsApp Ads. Each new lead gets an instant reply from your chatbot or team, and you can see which ad they came from. Qualify the lead, share a brochure and book a call before the lead goes cold.

features.name: Catalogue and payment links
features.content: Show your products inside WhatsApp, with photos, prices and details. Customers browse and pick items without leaving the chat. Send a payment link from your payment gateway and close the sale in the same conversation. The order confirmation then goes out automatically.

features.name: Up to 10 fallback templates
features.content: Meta can pause a template if its quality drops, or block it after review. With MSG91, you line up to 10 backup templates for each message. If one is paused or blocked, the next one sends straight away. Your campaign keeps running, and you don't lose sales while you fix the template.

features.name: Auto-retry, and no charge for failures
features.content: Messages can fail for temporary reasons, such as a network error. MSG91 retries failed messages on its own. You only pay for messages that are sent successfully, including the ones that go through on retry. Failed messages are never charged, so your budget goes only on messages that arrive.

features.name: Backup channels for critical messages
features.content: Some messages can't wait, like OTPs and payment alerts. Set SMS, email or voice as the backup for these. If the WhatsApp message fails, the backup goes out automatically, with no manual work. You choose which messages get a backup, so you pay for it only where it matters.

features.name: AI chatbot in your customer's language
features.content: Reply to customers any time, in their language and your brand's tone. The chatbot mixes fixed rule-based flows with AI in one bot, so key answers stay exact. It checks order status in your systems, books appointments and hands the chat to a person when needed. It solves up to 70% of chats on its own. (Needs a Hello plan.)

features.name: One inbox for every team and number
features.content: Add WhatsApp numbers for each brand, branch or emirate to one account. Every chat lands in one shared inbox and goes to the right agent or team automatically. Agents see the full chat history and customer details. Add unlimited agents with no per-agent fee.

features.name: Keep your WhatsApp Business app
features.content: Already using the WhatsApp Business app? Keep it. MSG91 connects the same number to the API, so the app and the API work together. Your team chats on the app as usual, while campaigns, OTPs and alerts go out through the API. Customers keep the number they already know.

features.name: Auto-blacklist that protects your number
features.content: Too many blocks and reports can lower your number's quality with Meta. To reduce this risk, send messages only to customers who have agreed to receive them and keep promotions relevant. When a customer replies "Stop", MSG91 adds them to a blacklist and stops sending them promotions. Their OTPs, order updates and other important messages still go through. Your number stays healthy and your customers stay happy.

features.name: Reports on every message
features.content: Track every message with detailed reports on sent, delivered, read, and clicked statuses. Compare templates to see which ones bring the most replies and sales. Export full message logs any time for your records or audits. Use the numbers to plan your next campaign with confidence.

FaqsComp.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About WhatsApp Business API in the UAE

faqs.question: Who is the best WhatsApp Business API provider in the UAE?
faqs.answer:
The best provider gives you lower prices, messages that always deliver, and reliable local support. As an official Meta Business Partner, MSG91 brings these benefits together, offering approximately 10% lower pricing than Meta to help businesses communicate with their customers more effectively while saving more.

In the UAE, MSG91 charges less than Meta's AED rates. It adds up to 10 fallback templates, auto-retry and auto-blacklist, so campaigns keep running and your number stays safe.

You also get an Arabic and English AI chatbot, a shared team inbox, data stored in the Gulf region, a UAE team, AED billing and 24/7 support.

faqs.question: How much does WhatsApp Business API cost in the UAE?
faqs.answer:
WhatsApp charges per message, and the price depends on the type: marketing, utility, authentication or service. With MSG91, UAE businesses pay 10% less than Meta's own AED rate for each message.

You pay only for messages that are sent. Failed messages are never charged, and that includes the ones MSG91 retries for you. MSG91 bills UAE clients in AED, and VAT applies.

See the latest rates on the MSG91 WhatsApp pricing page. If you send steady, high volumes every month, talk to our team about custom pricing.

faqs.question: Why use MSG91 instead of buying WhatsApp API directly from Meta?
faqs.answer:
Meta gives you the API, but not the tools around it. You would need to build your own dashboard, reports, retries and inbox. With MSG91, everything is ready from day one.

And you pay less. MSG91's per-message rates in the UAE are below Meta's own. You get an easy dashboard, reports on every message, auto-retry for failed messages and up to 10 backup templates.

Help is there 24/7 from people and AI. You can also add an AI chatbot, SMS, email, voice and Apple Messages, all from the same account.

faqs.question: Can I keep my WhatsApp Business app and use the API on the same number?
faqs.answer:
Yes. MSG91 supports coexistence, so the WhatsApp Business app and the API work together on one number. Your team keeps chatting with customers on the app, just like today.

At the same time, MSG91 sends your bulk and automated messages through the API. This includes campaigns, OTPs, order updates and reminders.

Your customers keep messaging the number they already know and trust. You keep your chat history, and you don't have to choose between the app and the API.

faqs.question: How fast can we go live with MSG91 WhatsApp in the UAE?
faqs.answer:
If your Meta business account is verified and your number is ready, you can connect it to MSG91 in about 10 minutes. A step-by-step help doc and video show you each step.

Keep your trade licence ready, as Meta may ask for it during business verification. You can start sending as soon as Meta approves your message templates.

If you get stuck, the MSG91 onboarding team helps you finish the setup. After you go live, support is there 24/7 by chat, email, WhatsApp and phone.

faqs.question: Where does MSG91 store data for UAE businesses?
faqs.answer:
MSG91 stores data for UAE businesses in data centres in the Gulf region. Your customer data stays close to home.

MSG91 is SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant. This means your data is protected by global security standards, with strict checks on who can access it.

MSG91 also has a registered office and a local team in the UAE. UAE clients are billed in AED with VAT invoices, which keeps your accounts simple. If your security or legal team has questions, our team can share the details they need.

faqs.question: What happens if an important WhatsApp message fails?
faqs.answer:
MSG91 tries again on its own. If it still fails, MSG91 can send it on a backup channel, so it still reaches your customer.

You can set SMS, email or voice as the backup for each message type. For example, if a WhatsApp OTP fails, it goes out as an SMS automatically, with no manual work. You choose which messages need a backup, so you use it only where it matters.

You never pay for failed WhatsApp messages. Your OTPs, payment alerts and order updates reach customers, and your costs stay under control.

faqs.question: Can many agents and teams use one WhatsApp number?
faqs.answer:
Yes. With MSG91 Hello, your whole team replies from one WhatsApp number. All chats land in one shared inbox and go to the right agent automatically. You can also add more numbers, for example one for each brand, branch or emirate.

An AI agent can answer common questions in Arabic and English. When a customer asks for a person, the chat moves to a human agent with the full history.

Hello plans include unlimited agents with no per-agent charge. So your support costs don't rise as your team grows.

faqs.question: Can I use WhatsApp Business API for both marketing and transactional messages?
faqs.answer:
Yes. WhatsApp Business Platform has four message types: marketing, utility, authentication and service. With MSG91, you send all of them from one account and one number.

Use marketing messages for opt-in offers and campaigns. Use utility messages for order updates, payment reminders, and booking confirmations. Use authentication messages for login codes. Meta prices each message type differently, while MSG91 offers lower rates across all categories.

MSG91 keeps them apart where it matters. When a customer replies "Stop", promotions stop, but their OTPs and order updates still arrive. Helping important messages reach customers.

faqs.question: Can MSG91 handle millions of WhatsApp messages at peak times?
faqs.answer:
Yes. MSG91 has 18 years of business messaging experience and sends millions of messages during peak periods like big sales and festive seasons. Messaging runs at 99.9% uptime, so OTPs, offers and order updates go out on time.

If a message fails, MSG91 retries it on its own. Multiple fallback templates keep big campaigns running, even if Meta pauses a template.

Support is open 24/7 by email, WhatsApp, phone, website chat and scheduled calls. Real people and AI agents help with everything from setup to daily use.
